content: A family of approaches BIBREF16, BIBREF17 seeks to compress the matrix parameters of the models by low-rank approximation i.e. the full-rank matrix parameter is approximated using multiple low-rank matrices, thereby reducing the effective number of model parameters. Another line of work explores parameter pruning and sharing-based methods BIBREF18, BIBREF19, BIBREF20, BIBREF21, which explore the redundancy in model parameters and try to remove redundant weights as well as neurons, for a variety of neural network architectures.
